author: nickyeow

english.text: She wept all the night.

jyutping: keoi5 haam3 zo2 seng4 maan5。
text: 佢喊咗成晚。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The turkeys in my grandfather's farm are very noisy, I can't wait for them to get eaten.

jyutping: ngo5 aa3 je4 nung4 coeng4 di1 fo2 gai1 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 cou4 saang1 saai3，zan1 hai6 soeng2 keoi5 dei6 faai3 di1 bei2 jan4 sik6 zo2 heoi3。
text: 我阿爺農場啲火雞成日喺度嘈生晒，真係想佢哋快啲俾人食咗去。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She's loved by her friends.

jyutping: keoi5 hou2 sau6 pang4 jau5 fun1 jing4。
text: 佢好受朋友歡迎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Sorry, the book is out of stock.

jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3，ni1 bun2 syu1 maai6 saai3 gaa3 laa3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Was the movie good?

english.text: To tell the truth, I would rather stay at home than go out.
To tell the truth, I'd rather stay home than go out.

jyutping: go3 lou5 si1 waa6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bui6 suk6 saai3 ni1 di1 jin6 jyu5 keoi5。

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 fong3 gung1 bat1 jyu4 heoi3 jam2 faan2 bui1 lo1？

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: Your mind is scattered. You're doing a poor job because you can't stay focused on a single task at a time.

jyutping: nei5 hoeng3 zyu6 saai3 so2 jau5 fong1 hoeng3 hai2 dou6 haang4 gan2，ji4 nei5 ge3 tau4 nou5 jau6 saan2 maan6，zung6 hoeng3 maai4 so2 jau5 co3 ng6 ge3 fong1 hoeng3 haang4，dim2 gaai2 nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 jat1 ci3 gwo3 zyun1 zyu3 faan2 hai2 go3 jam6 mou6 dou6？ nei5 jan1 wai6 gam3 ji4 zou6 gan2 jat1 fan6 caa1 di1 ge3 gung1 zok3。
text: 你向住晒所有方向喺度行緊，而你嘅頭腦又散漫，仲向埋所有錯誤嘅方向行，點解你唔可以一次過專注返喺個任務度？ 你因為咁而做緊一份差啲嘅工作。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: My sunny spot or "hidamari" is obscured today, there near under the branching potted plumeria at the balcony. Heavy rain last night and today, the 15th of August of 2025, it has been here on Lulu Island. The Trekker in me thinks that it's like planet Ferenginar, always drenched. In the morning at Tim Hortons, I enjoyed a sausage scrambled egg potato box and an oat-milk Earl Grey. There were two guys from Tashkent; one was more Mongoloid than the other. In the afternoon, back at the café, I saw in the line-up Jack the Chinese man in a brown jacket and Greg the white man married to a Japanese in Hokkaido. / plumeria leaves— / the rain makes planets / out of each droplet

jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 ge3 joeng4 gwong1 dim2 waak6 ze2「 hidamari 」bei6 ze1 zyu6 zo2，hai2 joeng4 toi4 ge3 fan1 zi1 pun4 zoi1 jyu5 mou4 haa6 min6 fu6 gan6。kam4 maan5 tung4 gam1 jat6，2025 nin4 8 jyut6 15 hou6 ge3 daai6 jyu5，lou6 lou6 dou2 ji5 ging1 lok6 zo2 jyu5。ngo5 jap6 min6 ge3 Trekker gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 ci5 fai3 leon4 gat1 naap6 sing1 kau4 gam2，seng4 jat6 dou1 sap1 saai3。ziu1 zou2 hai2 Tim Hortons sik6 zo2 go3 hoeng1 coeng2 caau2 daan2 syu4 zai2 hap6 tung4 bui1 jin3 mak6 naai5 baak3 zoek3 caa4。jau5 loeng5 go3 lai4 zi6 taap3 sap6 gon1 ge3 naam4 zai2；jat1 go3 bei2 ling6 jat1 go3 gang3 gaa1 ci5 mung4 gu2 jan4。haa6 zau3，faan2 dou3 gaa3 fe1 teng1，ngo5 hai2 paai4 deoi2 jap6 min6 gin3 dou2 Jack go3 zoek3 zyu6 fe1 sik1 ngoi6 tou3 ge3 zung1 gwok3 jan4，tung4 maai4 Greg go3 baak6 jan4，hai2 bak1 hoi2 dou6 tung4 go3 jat6 bun2 jan4 git3 fan1。 / jyu5 mou4 jip6 — / jyu5 seoi2 zai3 zou6 ceot1 haang4 sing1 / mui5 dik6 seoi2
text: 我今日嘅陽光點或者「 hidamari 」被遮住咗，喺陽台嘅分枝盆栽羽毛下面附近。琴晚同今日，2025年8月15號嘅大雨，露露島已經落咗雨。我入面嘅 Trekker 覺得佢好似費倫吉納星球噉，成日都濕晒。朝早喺 Tim Hortons 食咗個香腸炒蛋薯仔盒同杯燕麥奶伯爵茶。有兩個嚟自塔什干嘅男仔；一個比另一個更加似蒙古人。下晝，返到咖啡廳，我喺排隊入面見到 Jack 個着住啡色外套嘅中國人，同埋 Greg 個白人，喺北海道同個日本人結婚。 / 羽毛葉 — / 雨水製造出行星 / 每滴水
